facts.fact: Xalam Analytics (January 2026) estimates about 4 live commercial data centre facilities in Tanzania in 2025, leasing colocation space and power to third parties, with about 2.7 MW live IT load and about 60% occupancy; no facility is named.
facts.system: commercial data centre facilities in Tanzania (unnamed)

note: Also says large hyperscaler cloud regions are unlikely over the medium term; that is not a statement that none exists, so no cloud fact.
